description: List store products with pagination. Scope: `woo:products:read`. Args: search, status (draft|publish|...), stock_status (instock|outofstock|onbackorder), category (slug), per_page (≤100), page. Returns id/name/sku/type/status/price/stock per product plus total and has_more. Use this instead of SQL or PHP for any product question — it works the same whether or not the store uses High-Performance Order Storage.

site.description: Site alias to target (e.g. "guns2ammo"). Omit when only one site is configured.

name: bridgistic_woo_list_products
title: List WooCommerce products
